title: Property Credit and Spa Entitlements Carried by the Hotel Rate Plans
content:
Four of the seven Hotel Rate Plans include property credit granted for use on site, and five carry a spa discount. The figures are recorded plan by plan below.

| Rate plan | Property credit per stay, USD | Validity from arrival, calendar days | A companion sharing the room may spend it | Spa discount, percent |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Non-Refundable Saver Rate | 0.0 | 0 | no | 0 |
| Advance Purchase 21 Rate | 0.0 | 0 | no | 0 |
| Semi-Flexible Rate | 0.0 | 0 | no | 5 |
| Standard Flexible Rate | 25.0 | 3 | no | 10 |
| Member Flex Rate | 50.0 | 5 | yes | 15 |
| Suite Flexible Rate | 100.0 | 7 | yes | 20 |
| All-Inclusive Flex Rate | 200.0 | 10 | yes | 25 |

**Property credit per stay** is the amount granted at check-in for use on site. **Validity** is the number of calendar days from check-in within which the credit must be spent. **Transferability** records whether a companion sharing the room may spend it. The **spa discount** is the percentage taken off spa treatments booked during the stay.

## Points of judgement

*Where the credit is nothing.* The Non-Refundable Saver Rate, the Advance Purchase 21 Rate and the Semi-Flexible Rate record 0.0 USD and a validity of 0 days alike. The Semi-Flexible Rate is the only one of the three that nonetheless carries a spa discount, at 5 percent.

*Where a companion may spend it.* The three plans that allow it are the same three that record the longest validity terms, 5, 7 and 10 days. The Standard Flexible Rate grants 25.0 USD for 3 days and reserves it to the lead guest.

*A worked reading.* On the Suite Flexible Rate this schedule records 100.0 USD of credit valid for 7 calendar days from arrival, so an arrival on the 1st leaves the 8th as the last day inside a 7-day term counted from the 1st.
